instructions.terse: Which team should handle this support ticket?

policy.question: Which Tallyfern support queue should handle this ticket? Check the rules in precedence order and choose the first queue whose rule matches.
precedence: 1. Any sign of account compromise, fraud or unauthorized activity, anywhere in the ticket: trust_safety.
2. Any report that Tallyfern is down or broadly failing, anywhere in the ticket: incident_response.
3. Any mention of a chargeback or a bank or card dispute, anywhere in the ticket: billing_disputes.
4. Otherwise, route by the customer's main request using each queue's covers and excludes.
5. If the ticket does not state a fact a rule needs (amount, timing, API version), treat that condition as not met.
policy.account_fields: state.customer holds the CRM fields: plan, region, seats and sso_enabled.

covers: Suspected or confirmed account compromise: someone else logged in, password or 2FA changed without the customer
Payout bank details changed without the customer's knowledge
Invoices or payments the customer did not create
Phishing emails or sites imitating Tallyfern
excludes: Ordinary sign-in problems with no sign of unauthorized activity (account_access or enterprise_identity)

covers: Tallyfern itself down or broadly failing: dashboard not loading, checkout or payments failing across the board, every API request erroring
Applies even when the outage is mentioned alongside another request
excludes: A single failed invoice, payment or API call (route by the main request)
Anything with signs of account compromise (trust_safety)

covers: A chargeback or dispute filed with a bank or card issuer, by the customer against a Tallyfern charge or by one of their payers
Applies even when the main request is a refund
excludes: Refund requests with no chargeback or dispute filed (billing_refunds or finance_review)

covers: Refund of a Tallyfern charge where the amount is more than $500
Refund of a Tallyfern charge made more than 30 days before the ticket
excludes: Refunds of $500 or less charged 30 days ago or less (billing_refunds)
Refunds where amount and timing are not stated (billing_refunds)
Any refund that also mentions a chargeback or bank dispute (billing_disputes)

covers: Refunds of $500 or less, charged 30 days ago or less (exactly $500 and exactly 30 days count as standard)
Refund requests that do not state the amount or the timing
excludes: Refunds over $500 or charged more than 30 days ago (finance_review)
Any refund that also mentions a chargeback or bank dispute (billing_disputes)

covers: The customer's own payout to their bank account failed, is late, or arrived short
excludes: Payout bank details changed without the customer's knowledge (trust_safety)
Refunds of Tallyfern charges (billing_refunds or finance_review)

covers: API errors from an integration that uses the v1 API
excludes: API errors on v2, or where the version is not stated (api_support)
Every request failing because Tallyfern is down (incident_response)

covers: API errors on the v2 API
API errors where the version is not stated
excludes: API errors on the v1 API (legacy_api)
Every request failing because Tallyfern is down (incident_response)

covers: Sign-in problems on accounts with plan enterprise and sso_enabled true
excludes: Sign-in problems on any other account, including enterprise accounts without SSO (account_access)
Sign-in problems with signs of unauthorized activity (trust_safety)

covers: Forgotten passwords, 2FA codes not arriving, locked accounts
Sign-in problems on any account that is not enterprise with SSO enabled
excludes: Enterprise accounts with sso_enabled true (enterprise_identity)
Sign-in problems with signs of unauthorized activity (trust_safety)

covers: Requests for a copy of the customer's data, or for deletion, when the account region is eu or uk
excludes: The same requests from any other region (general_support)

covers: Plan or seat changes when the account has 50 or more seats
Plan or seat changes on enterprise accounts
excludes: Plan or seat changes on non-enterprise accounts with fewer than 50 seats (general_support)

covers: Billing questions: how an invoice was calculated, updating a card, tax fields
How-to questions about using Tallyfern
Data access or deletion requests outside the EU and UK
Plan or seat changes on non-enterprise accounts with fewer than 50 seats
excludes: Anything a more specific queue covers
